'''Hal Razor''' was a criminal who founded and commanded the [[Razor Runners]], a group of bandits who operated on the [[Volcano/Legends|volcanic]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]].<ref name="Trials" />

==Behind the scenes==
Hal Razor appeared as a non-player character in the video game ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], 2011.
